audit.why: Difficulty EVEN / 5.5-10 matches the 51.79% win rate over 2149 games. Early lane belongs to Karma (950 Inner Flame vs your 900 Q, Inspire shield on top), the lane flips at 6 with Between Worlds. Level chart Karma/Karma/Karma/Aurora x4 agrees with the packet chart and both layers agree with each other.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text asserts Karma can 'one-shot with mantra-Q from max range' — a magnitude the kit does not support.
audit.why: Mantra is a free cast (0 cost) on a 40/38/36/34 cooldown reduced by every damaging spell she lands (Gathering Fire). That is the real late-game fact; a one-shot claim is invented.
audit.corrected: Replace with the mana-free Mantra cadence and the empowered Q siege threat.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] names a 'Soulflare root-detonate combo'. Karma has no ability by that name in the current kit; the root is Focused Resolve (W).
audit.why: Riot's kit lists W = Focused Resolve, a 675-range tether on a flat 12s cooldown that roots only if the tether is not broken by leaving range. Mantra-W extends the root AND heals her. E = Inspire, shield plus move speed. Your W (22/21/20/19/18) is the break tool; your R zone slow denies the walk-out after her tether is spent.
audit.corrected: Name Focused Resolve and Inspire; state that the tether breaks on range, not on time.

audit.why: breakdown.cooldowns carries real numbers: Focused Resolve flat 12s at every rank, Inner Flame 9s at rank 1 down to 5s at rank 5, Mantra 40/38/36/34 shortened by Gathering Fire.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentions that Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve heals Karma, so Grievous Wounds timing is never raised.
audit.why: The _missing entry flags exactly this: Karma sustains through chip via Mantra-W. Extended trades and late-game focus fire change on anti-heal timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: lintFindings: dosFull[1].d is the tradeGood string verbatim and dontsFull[2].d is the tradeBad string verbatim, both under unrelated titles. dosFull[2].d also describes the tether gap under a title about the R zone.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed — the title promises one thing and the body explains another.
audit.corrected: Each bullet rewritten to answer its own title, grounded in Karma's cooldowns.

edits.before: Her Soulflare root-detonate combo still threatens you and her shield absorbs your early damage
edits.after: Her Focused Resolve tether roots you if you stay in range and Inspire's shield eats your early damage

edits.before: Your all-in burst outpaces her sustained poke unless she's stacked enough AP to one-shot with mantra-Q from max range.
edits.after: Your all-in burst outpaces her poke, yet Mantra costs no mana and returns every 34s at rank 4 — respect the empowered Q.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, E her step-up, Q-recast the slowed target, hop out — a full pattern she answered with an empty tether.
edits.after: When Inner Flame whiffs she has 9s at rank 1 to wait — step up, land Q, E her, recast the curse, and leave before it returns.

edits.before: Karma burns Focused Resolve and you break the tether — take the twelve-second invitation.
edits.after: R leaves a slow zone you can teleport across, so Karma cannot walk her 950 poke out of range.

edits.before: Hopping IN with W while her Mantra is charged — Mantra-W extends the root and heals her, so the exit spent as an entrance is a free kill for her.
edits.after: W is 22s at rank 1 and it is your only way out of a tether that lasts until you leave 675 range — spend it on her Focused Resolve, not on a wave.

edits.before: R the clump and force Karma to choose: shield one target with Inspire or Mantra it for the whole line. Kill her while she decides.
edits.after: R the clump so Karma must shield one target with Inspire or Mantra it for the line; Mantra-W heals her, so land Grievous Wounds first.

notes: Level chart left untouched: packet levelChart, phases[].side and win[] all agree (Karma 1-3, Aurora 4-7) and the whys match the sides. No mirror audit existed for karma_mid vs aurora at write time, so these findings are original and should be restated from Karma's side when that direction is audited. Aurora's own passive is a spirit heal, not anti-heal — the kit file's 'heal: anti-heal target' flag on her P is a derived-flag misfire against Riot's own description; I did not write anything from it.
